text: まけたら　ひとりめ　から　やりなおしに　なるぞ！

structure.jp: やりなおしに　なるぞ！

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that thing happens. まけたら = 'if you lose'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: やりなおしに　なる
patterns.explanation: に　なる after a thing says that is how matters end up. やりなおしに　なる = 'it ends up being a do-over'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is rough, mostly male speech that pushes the point at the listener. なるぞ = 'it will, I'm telling you!'.
